newsitem.title: USA: Dataware Tech says CFO Clarke to resign.
newsitem.headline: Dataware Tech says CFO Clarke to resign.

text.p: Dataware Technologies Inc, a maker of electronic publishing software, said Friday its chief financial officer, Daniel Clarke, is resigning effective August 22.
Michael Gonnerman, an independent financial consultant who was formerly connected with the accounting firm Arthur Andersen, will serve as interim CFO effective August 25, the company said.
Gonnerman will be CFO while the company evaluates a permanent replacement, it said.
Dataware said Clarke will be joining a high technology company in the greater Boston area. It did not identify the company.
